messages.subject: Re: looking for R script
parts:
Jordi:

For analysis of line transect data in R (using the methods described in
Buckland et al. (2001)) you can use either the mrds package (available
on github at https://github.com/jlaake/mrds) or unmarked (available on
CRAN http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/unmarked/index.html)
